renderings.technical:
### Changed

- Integrate the complete M9 Frontend Redesign milestone into `main` as a single coherent release point, reconciling the two divergent M9 branches and adding the v1.9.0 release notes. ([#244](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/244))

### Added

- Re-introduce inline citation badges in the assistant Markdown answer, anchored after the cited passage title, with hover and focus tooltips showing source, heading and snippet, while keeping the sanitized Markdown rendering and unanchored citations in the sources list. ([#245](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/245))
- Turn the first suggested next step into a primary button that executes the step through the same command handler as the manual path, with remaining steps in an overflow menu, and a generic fallback when no step is actionable. ([#237](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/237))
- Add a keyboard-operable command palette opened with Ctrl/Cmd+K from every page, listing navigation targets from the navigation registry and debounced, cancellable ticket search results. ([#236](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/236))
- Apply ticket status changes optimistically on the board and detail view, roll back to the prior state on a rejected transition with the error code in a snackbar, and reconcile only with the newest move. ([#235](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/235))
- Replace the assign and change-status dialogs with inline popover menus on the ticket header that apply changes in place through the same command handlers, keeping scroll position and the open tab. ([#234](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/234))
- Render streamed assistant citations as inline badges placed after the matched answer text, with a keyboard-focusable tooltip, and keep a numbered sources list for citations the model did not anchor inline. ([#233](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/233))
- Inject the active agent roster into the assistant system prompt on every chat request, from the same query the assign tool validates against, and instruct the model to use only those names. ([#221](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/221))
- Force a `check_grounding` tool call through tool choice once retrieved passages exist and no check has run in the run, so the grounding verdict is computed before the answer streams, for both the interactive assistant and the autonomous worker. ([#218](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/218))
- Centralize palette, spacing, radius, elevation and semantic colour in one design-token source rendered as document custom properties and used by the MudBlazor theme and all stylesheets, and change the KPI card accent to a tone enum. ([#213](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/213))

### Fixed

- Wrap the board card title in a row element so the two-line clamp with ellipsis applies and long titles no longer grow the card without bound. ([#240](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/240))
- Target the assistant chat panel with a deep selector so its padding and flex layout apply, keeping the composer send button inside the panel. ([#239](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/239))
- Give the Category column in the ticket queue a fixed width and an uppercase header matching its neighbours, so it no longer overlaps the Due column, while remaining a static label rather than a sort control. ([#238](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/238))
- Add a system prompt rule that the assistant must not state a change happened without a successful tool result in the conversation, and must not ask for confirmation again when the user has already requested the change, except for genuine decisions. ([#223](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/223))
- Render ticket summary timestamps in the configured user timezone with an explicit zone header, so the streamed summary matches the times shown in the ticket detail view. ([#222](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/222))
- Return an error result when the knowledge-base search fails with a non-transient exception, distinct from the unavailable result, so the dashboard error rate reflects real failures. ([#220](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/220))
- Score assistant grounding by sentence-level semantic similarity to retrieved passages, falling back to the lexical evaluator when embeddings are unavailable or fail, so paraphrases and translations are no longer scored as ungrounded. ([#219](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/219))
